failure_modes: If a time-conditioned recipe (C008-C011) were applied on this evidence, the conflicting first-rate/last-rate signs and repeated sign changes would likely produce a non-reproducible signed contrast, so the temporal teacher term would add noise rather than a stable direction and could displace surrounding coordinates without affinity gain.

If pointcloud_delta_A were changed to 0.5 or 2.0 A (C001/C003) without spatial-scale evidence, the rho_delta curvature would be altered in an unvalidated direction, risking either over-soft matching that ignores endpoint mismatch or over-hard matching that drives unnecessary coordinate displacement and strain.

If teacher_neighbors were narrowed to 2 (C005), mode coverage of the detached teacher mixture would shrink and competing directions could be dropped; if broadened to 8 (C007), the neighborhood would mix distinct modes, both without any delivered dispersion evidence to justify the change.

Retaining the incumbent leaves any true affinity benefit from an unread spatial or regional signal unrealized; this is accepted because the affinity-first objective forbids unsupported coordinate edits and no current study outcome data are available to either role.
rationale: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control, and the observed window is the score-time interval [0.0,0.5] in native endpoint world coordinates. The only delivered temporal evidence is the first six landmark_00 continuous_trends rows: no polynomial fit is accepted, all are restricted to observed-node interpolation with extrapolation disallowed, relative node RMSE is high (about 0.29-0.78), sign changes and strong sign conflicts are frequent, and whole-window z values are small and mixed in sign. That is exactly the condition under which H001 says a constant rule is not yet outperformed, so no time-conditioned teacher-coordinate or regional-attention recipe (C008-C011) is supported. The spatial choices C001-C003 change only the pointcloud_delta_A dose of the registered rho_delta curvature; the incumbent already uses delta=1.0 A (C002), and no delivered spatial-scale or uncertainty evidence distinguishes 0.5 or 2.0 A, so a dose change would be an unsupported exploratory edit rather than a defensible expected advantage. The teacher_neighbors choices C005-C007 are counts, not distance bandwidths, and no intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence was delivered to justify narrowing or broadening the neighborhood; the incumbent count of 4 is retained. C004 (region_index 0) is a static regional selection with no supporting regional_effects evidence read. Because the affinity-first priority means an unsupported coordinate edit risks unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates without a demonstrated affinity benefit, and because the evidence does not change the incumbent-versus-alternative comparison, retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed.
